label: VERIFIED
extraction: CrewAI: open-source Python framework (58k+ stars) with two approaches. Crews: optimize for autonomy and collaborative intelligence with role-based AI agents. Flows: build event-driven automations combining precise workflow control, single LLM calls, and native Crew support. Features: tracing & observability (real-time metrics, logs, traces), unified control plane (centralized platform for managing, monitoring, scaling agents). Agents assigned roles like Researcher, Writer, Critic. Sequential and Hierarchical processes. Emphasizes grounding agent answers in real data. Practical tutorials for multi-agent systems fundamentals and advanced implementations. CrewAI enables production-ready multi-agent workflows with high-level abstractions and low-level APIs.
